_readme: JoJo's Blocks — CENTRAL PRODUCT DATA. This is the single source of truth for every product on the website. Edit this file to add or change a book; never edit a generated book page by hand. Generated files: books/*.html, sitemap.xml, llms.txt (and later js/products.js). Generator: tools/generate-pages.js — run 'node tools/generate-pages.js --only <slug>' for one page or '--all' for everything. Paid PDF files are NEVER stored in this repository: the only purchase link is gumroadUrl. Free resources will live in a separate data/free-resources.json (not created until the first free resource exists) so paid and free products are never mixed. Fields marked null are UNKNOWN, not zero — do not guess them. Status 'published' means 'listed on the live website'. Contact email set 2026-11-14: jojobusiness0101@gmail.com. Pinterest profile verified 2026-11-14: https://www.pinterest.com/JoJosBlocks/ . Instagram @rz.views is intentionally NOT linked: its profile publicly displays the owner's first name, which conflicts with the brand-only identity rule. License default (owner-approved proposal, 2026-11-14): personal-family (Personal + Family Use); Single-Classroom Use is a future add-on, not a separate product yet. Ages for Animal Explorer, Community Helpers and the Bundle are still null — proposed ranges (3-6, 4-7, 2-7) are working recommendations only and must NOT be published until the owner confirms them. US English throughout since 2026-11-14 (coloring, favorite, license).
